howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From sign-up to working together, in 6 simple steps

1.title: Sign Up
1.description: Create a free account as a business or a worker. Signing up takes less than a minute.

2.title: Complete Your Profile
2.description: Add your skills, experience and preferences. If you're a business, describe your needs and post jobs.

3.title: Discover Matches
3.description: Our AI analyses your data and suggests the most relevant matches. Swipe right on the profiles you like.

4.title: Match!
4.description: When both sides show interest, a match is created. You're notified instantly on your phone and computer.

5.title: Chat
5.description: Start a conversation through the built-in chat. Discuss details, hours, pay and anything else you need.

6.title: Work Together
6.description: Seal the deal and start working together. Rate your experience to help other users.

cookie.title: We respect your privacy
cookie.p1: We and our partners store and/or access information on a device, such as cookies, and process personal data, such as unique identifiers and standard information sent by a device, for personalised advertising and content, advertising and content measurement, audience research and service development.
cookie.p2: With your permission, we and our partners may use precise geolocation data and identification through device scanning. You may click to consent to our and our partners' processing as described above.
cookie.p3: Alternatively, you may click to refuse to consent, or access more detailed information and change your preferences before consenting. Please note that some processing of your personal data may not require your consent, but you have the right to object to such processing.
cookie.p4a: Your preferences will apply to this website only. You can change your preferences or withdraw your consent at any time by returning to this website and clicking the
cookie.p4b: link at the bottom of the page.
cookie.necessaryDesc: Cookies that are strictly required for the site to work (login, security, language preference, saving your choices). Without them the platform does not function.
cookie.analyticsDesc: Help us understand how the platform is used (page views, clicks, sessions) so we can improve the experience. Anonymous data — they do not identify you.
cookie.marketingDesc: Third-party cookies (Meta, Google) for targeted advertising and remarketing when you visit other sites. You can disable them without affecting functionality.
